confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors rest on several Florence-specific aggregator figures that broadly agree, though most are undated. Cocktail and wine anchors are thinner: the cocktail source dates from 2024, and wine is inferred from wine-bar ranges. Accommodation is low confidence: the hostel figures come from booking-site summaries, the hotel sources conflict (a Skyscanner 3-star average of about USD 130-150 versus summer peak-season expectations), and July is high season, so the figures were set above the all-season averages. Euro figures were converted at roughly 1.15 USD per EUR, the rate implied by the price sources, not a live rate. The FX observation is the RBA figure for 16 October 2026 as listed in the RBA statistics table; the 15 October figure of 0.6955 was confirmed on the RBA overview page.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Anchors are based on Florence-specific aggregated sources (Citycost, Whereandwhen, Expatistan, Okvoyage, Savvy Backpacker) plus hostel and hotel listing summaries, adjusted for July high season.
